name: pm-skills
description: 68 product management skills (30 phase + 11 foundation + 12 utility + 15 tool) plus 6 sub-agents (pm-critic, pm-skill-auditor, pm-changelog-curator, pm-release-conductor, pm-workflow-orchestrator, pm-skill-router) for AI agents covering the full product lifecycle from discovery through iteration. v2.33.0 fixes the three defects users actually reported: the persona example now matches the template it ships with, prioritization works for lists shorter than ten and for research thinner than a formal survey, and four skills no longer dead-end by pointing at a sibling skill you have not installed. It also opens the AI-product family, adding sections for specifying model-backed features to deliver-prd, measure-instrumentation-spec and develop-adr. No new skills; catalog stays 68 skills / 6 sub-agents. Full release history: https://github.com/product-on-purpose/pm-skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
